name: The Triad — Multi-Agent Research Pipeline
description: Three autonomous agents (Cleo/Cron, Otto/Hermes, Vrilnius/OpenClaw) collaborate through DKG v10 Working + Shared Memory to build a cross-referenced knowledge graph. Zero gas MVP; each agent writes to a shared Context Graph with full provenance chaining (researchedFrom → basedOn).

install.usageHint:
Clone the repo, configure DKG auth, and run:
  git clone https://github.com/CG1up/triad-dkg-bounty
  cd triad-dkg-bounty
  cp scripts/.dkg-config.json.example scripts/.dkg-config.json
  # Edit .dkg-config.json with your DKG node's auth token
  python3 scripts/query-triad.py --summary

Each agent script is standalone:
  python3 scripts/research-to-dkg.py --title "..." --source-url "..." --findings "..." --verdict adopt
  python3 scripts/artifact-to-dkg.py --type code --project "..." --summary "..." --path "..."
  python3 scripts/reading-queue-worker.py  # Cleo cron worker
  ./demo.sh  # Full end-to-end demo

security.notes: All agents share a single local Edge Node. Auth token stored in .dkg-config.json (gitignored). Cleo uses local Ollama for URL classification — no external API egress. Otto and Vrilnius use user's existing LLM APIs (DeepSeek V4, GPT-4o). All DKG writes via subprocess.run() with explicit args — no shell injection vectors. Never calls PUBLISH or SHARE — Working + Shared Memory only. No npm publish required (standalone Python scripts).

promotionPath: All three agents write to Working Memory via 'dkg workspace write' (free, local SQLite). The data is immediately queryable via SPARQL across Shared Memory ('dkg query --include-shared-memory'). The promotion path to Verified Memory is explicit but deferred to Round 2: once the context graph is registered on-chain, calling 'dkg workspace publish' promotes staged assertions to Verified Memory with on-chain anchoring. The integration is designed so that no code changes are needed — the same N-Quads triples carry through all three layers. Round 2 adds: per-agent DIDs with signing keys, multi-node deployment (one Edge Node per agent), auto-promotion cron, and a public SPARQL endpoint for context oracle consumption.
fitNotes: The Triad directly advances the autonomous research pipeline direction described in the ERC-8004 specification. By connecting a reading-queue worker (Cleo) → research agent (Otto) → build agent (Vrilnius) through DKG's content-addressed memory, it demonstrates how agent-native knowledge graphs can eliminate the 'context silo' problem where each agent's output is invisible to others. The provenance chain (researchedFrom → basedOn) creates a verifiable lineage from raw URL ingestion through to built artifact — this is the exact pattern needed for LLM-Wiki style autonomous knowledge curation at scale.
